commentary.text: 90+12' Adrian Cordero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+12' Vitor Roque (Betis) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+12' Vitor Roque (Betis) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

90+11' Francisco Vieites (Betis) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Karl Hein keeps the ball out.
90+9' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+9' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+9' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
90+8' Isco (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+7' Isco (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
90+7' Juanmi (Betis) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
90+5' Vitor Roque (Betis) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90+3' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Karl Hein was forced into action to thwart Jesus Rodriguez (Betis). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
89' It is time for a substitution. Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is on for Marcos Andre.
89' Kike Perez just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) replaces him.
87' Kike Perez (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' The game is interrupted now, Karl Hein (Valladolid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

83' The ball unexpectedly rebounds out to Juanmi (Betis) on the edge of the box, but his attempt is lame and ends up well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
82' Problems for Diego Cocca as Anuar is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) replaces him.
82' Anuar (Valladolid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' A pass from Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is intercepted by Karl Hein and the move breaks down.
80' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick to Betis.
77' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero had an easy-decision to make.
75' The substitution has been made. Mateo Flores (Betis) has replaced Giovani Lo Celso.

75' Jesus Rodriguez slings in a great lofted ball towards Juanmi (Betis), who doesn't get the best of contacts but still sends a close-range header inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
74' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) replaces Youssouf Sabaly.
73' Here's the change. Abde Ezzalzouli leaves the pitch and Juanmi (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
73' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

72' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
71' The game is interrupted now, Raul Moro (Valladolid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Perez (Valladolid) was quite harsh and Adrian Cordero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' Valladolid take a short corner kick.
70' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Adrian Cordero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Kike Perez (Valladolid) forces a pass into the box, but Francisco Vieites is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
68' Isco (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
68' Luis Perez swings the cross over. Marcos Andre (Valladolid) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
64' What a long-range shot by Marcos Andre (Valladolid). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
63' Mario Martin (Valladolid) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
62' The attendance for today's match is 21911.
61' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Cedric Bakambu and he is replaced by Vitor Roque (Betis).
61' A substitution has been made. Sergi Altimira is replaced by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
60' Betis are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
58' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Rosa plays a pass to the feet of Kike Perez (Valladolid), and he shoots inside the left post from inside the box. It's 1:0.
55' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle as Raul Moro (Valladolid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
55' David Torres comes onto the pitch after Eray Comert (Valladolid) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
54' Eray Comert (Valladolid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

54' This was a piece of cake for Karl Hein. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
52' Adrian Cordero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Stanko Juric (Valladolid) and blew his whistle.
52' A cross into the box from Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is cleared.
51' Great teamplay by Valladolid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
48' Rough tackle by Sergi Altimira (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Diego Cocca probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Abdulay Juma Bah (Valladolid). He is replaced by Eray Comert.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.

44' Adrian Cordero blows for a foul after Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Betis will take a free kick.
42' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.

41' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
40' Corner kick. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is ready to send the ball into the box.
39' Isco (Betis) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
38' Adrian Cordero interrupts the game. One of the players from Valladolid won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. That's a free kick to Betis.
37' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) does well to meet a cross from Lucas Rosa, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
35' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) was too forceful with his tackle and Adrian Cordero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
35' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Valladolid is cautioned for aggressive play.
34' Raul Moro (Valladolid) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
32' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:4. Shots on target – 0:0.
30' A player from Valladolid commits a rough challenge. Adrian Cordero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
28' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Diego Llorente (Betis) for his blatant foul.
25' Isco (Betis) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
25' Isco (Betis) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
22' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
22' Looks like Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

20' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
19' Kike Perez (Valladolid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
17' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes. 39:61 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' Raul Moro (Valladolid) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.

14' A rebound falls to Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
12' Isco (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
12' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
11' Diego Llorente (Betis) trips an opposition player and Adrian Cordero signals a foul.
11' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.

9' Kike Perez floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Mario Martin (Valladolid) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just wide of the left post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
8' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Valladolid are awarded a free kick.
5' Betis enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) forces a pass into the box, but Karl Hein is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
1' What a big chance! Anuar (Valladolid) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
